name: SiteEase Smart AJAX Product Filter
author: iflairwebtechnologies

sections.description:
SiteEase Smart AJAX Product Filter is a lightweight and user-friendly WooCommerce plugin that helps customers quickly find products using dynamic, AJAX-based filtering.

The plugin enables filtering products by price, categories, tags, attributes, and product name, with results updating instantly without refreshing the page. This improves the overall shopping experience and helps customers find relevant products faster.

It includes an easy-to-use admin settings panel, allowing store owners to configure filter options, customize labels, and control the appearance and behavior of the filtering interface.

Key Features

  • AJAX-Based Product Filtering
    Filter products instantly without page reloads.

  • Multiple Filter Options
    Filter by price, categories, tags, attributes (such as size or color), and product name.

  • Custom Filter Management
    Enable or disable filters and control which product attributes appear in the filter panel.

  • Easy Admin Configuration
    Customize filter headings, labels, colors, and layout from the admin panel.

  • Sidebar Filter Widget
    Display filters in the shop sidebar or supported widget areas.

  • Product Count Display
    Shows the total number of products before and after filtering.

  • Fully Responsive Design
    Optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

  • WooCommerce Compatible
    Designed specifically for WooCommerce and compatible with the latest WordPress and PHP versions.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Search for SiteEase Smart AJAX Product Filter.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Navigate to the plugin settings page from the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Configure filter options and display settings.
  6. Visit the WooCommerce shop page to see the filters in action.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

This plugin adds AJAX-based product filtering to WooCommerce shop pages, allowing customers to filter products without reloading the page.

Which filters are supported?

Products can be filtered by price, categories, tags, attributes (such as size and color), and product name.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. The plugin is fully responsive and works on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

Is coding knowledge required?

No. All configuration options are available through an easy-to-use admin settings panel.
